title: Bridge Base Online Board Daily Event Volume
dataSources: BoardGameGeek plays (`bgg:play`), Poker Now sessions (`pokernow:session`), Bridge Base Online boards (`bridgebase:board`), and Lichess tournament rounds (`lichess:tournament`).
app: BoardGameGeek play logs, Poker Now session exports, Bridge Base Online boards, and Lichess tournament data ingested into Splunk.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=bridgebase:board
| bin _time span=1d
| stats count as events, dc(partnership_name) as distinct_entities by _time
| sort - _time
description: Counts how many Bridge Base Online board events land each day and how many distinct partnership name values are represented.
value: Daily volume is the fastest way to spot a dead feed, a sudden burst, or a workflow that quietly changed.
implementation: Ingest Bridge Base Online board records into `index=personal`; schedule daily and compare count and distinct partnership name values against your normal baseline.
visualization: Column chart of daily event count with a line for distinct entities.
grandmaExplanation: It lists how much Bridge Base Online board activity showed up each day so you can see if the feed went quiet or suddenly got busy.
